races.paceDynamic: Crimson Rose, Nevasca Cinza, and Aigeas will establish a fierce early gallop with all three having confirmed front-running styles and proven pace credentials. This triumvirate will stretch the field from the outset, creating a relentless tempo that will severely test stamina reserves over the 6f trip on good to firm ground. The sustained pressure will crack weaker horses early, leaving the finish to those who can either sustain the gallop from the front or have the class to close strongly. This pace scenario decisively favours hold-up horses with proven class who can benefit from the collapse ahead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners burn each other out in a suicidal early gallop
scenarios.body: The leaders will weaken dramatically in the final furlong, allowing a classy closer to pick up the pieces. Westport's proven winning form and hold-up style makes him the prime beneficiary of this likely meltdown.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters has enough left after seeing off their rivals
scenarios.body: Crimson Rose or Nevasca Cinza could prove tough enough to withstand the early battle and hold on grimly. Their superior ratings and recent form give them the edge over Aigeas in a war of attrition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers possesses unexposed class to exploit the pace setup
scenarios.body: A well-bred newcomer from Burke or Appleby's yard could time their run perfectly as the pace collapses. The hold-up runners among the debutants will have ideal conditions to showcase hidden ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Even Gallop Tactical
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders settle into a more measured rhythm after initial skirmishing
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sustainable, turning it into a test of pure ability rather than stamina. The highest-rated horses would then prevail in a straightforward contest.

watchPoints.text: Crimson Rose and Nevasca Cinza going too fast early could set up dramatic pace collapse
Westport's fitness after 277-day break for Crimson Rose could be crucial factor
Any of the Burke, Appleby or Easterby debutants showing early pace could signal market confidence
The good to firm ground may play against some of the hold-up horses who prefer softer conditions
Watch for which jockeys commit to tracking the early leaders versus holding back for late run

races.paceDynamic: Court Alert will take the field along at a sustainable gallop with no obvious pace pressure from the front. The majority of runners are prominent/midfield types (I'll Be Back, Beagle Bay, Dumuji) who will track the leader in a compact group, while the hold-up horses (King's Cavalry, Clough, Mertoun) will need to rely on the pace quickening enough in the final stages. With only one confirmed front-runner and several prominent racers content to sit just behind, this sets up as a steadily-run race that will come down to who can quicken best from the 2f pole. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and strike, as they'll get the ideal position without having to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Court Alert sets steady fractions and the prominent group stays compact
scenarios.body: The experienced prominent runners (Beagle Bay, I'll Be Back) will be perfectly positioned to pounce when the pace lifts at the 2f marker. Hold-up horses will struggle to make up the ground against runners already in striking position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Unraced Newcomer Springs
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers has significant ability and benefits from the steady pace
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop will suit a well-schooled newcomer who can quicken sharply from a handy position. Court Alert's honest pace-setting will create the perfect platform for a talented debutant to show their hand late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Court Alert goes too slow early and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: King's Cavalry's strong finishing kick will be most effective if the pace collapses into a dash from the 2f pole. The class horse will need plenty of room and a true-run race to showcase his ability from the rear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Court Alert gets soft fractions and finds another gear when challenged
scenarios.body: The pace-setter will benefit from an uncontested lead and having something left when the prominent runners come to challenge. Court Alert's recent form suggests he can sustain a gallop when headed.

races.paceDynamic: Serviceman will lead or press from the front with Alta Rica likely to sit handy, creating a modest gallop through the early stages of this 1m4f contest. This setup strongly favors hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks, particularly those with proven stamina at the trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Monk's Hill wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If Monk's Hill gets an easy lead while Give Me Sun struggles
scenarios.body: The 50-rated leader gets first run on his rivals and proves hard to peg back despite the low rating. His recent 2nd at 7f suggests he can handle this trip when getting things his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go off too slowly and no one challenges
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with no real pace to aim at. The most progressive horses with tactical speed can quickest exploit the lack of early tempo.

watchPoints.text: Give Me Sun may not be match-fit after 208 days off despite being prominent in the betting
Traffic problems guaranteed at the 3f pole with seven horses wanting the same prominent positions
Monk's Hill could steal this if getting an uncontested lead with Give Me Sun below par
Fullstop and Starakova both show fade patterns that make them risky at current odds
Tickettothestars' hold-up style perfectly matches the likely pace scenario
